title: Release SemVer rater observation (v1)
description: One independent rater's bare observation over exactly one evidence pack. It is observation evidence for a calibrated fast-mlsirm estimator, not a release decision. It deliberately has no confidence or self-reported probability field and no output version.
$comment: Immutable once released. Any change requires a new vN directory and MANIFEST entry. Consumers must also reject documents larger than 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

evidence_sha256.description: Echo of the evidence pack digest the rater was given. A mismatch invalidates the observation.

assignment_ref.description: Opaque rater-assignment reference issued by the caller; echoed unchanged.

observed_class.description: The SemVer change class this rater observes in the evidence, or abstain.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence-pack refs that support the observed class. Must be refs present in the evidence pack; that membership check is performed by the consumer.

breaking_change_refs.description: Evidence-pack refs this rater considers backward-incompatible.

reason_code.description: Bounded machine-readable reason. Required when abstaining.
